PRODUCT OVERVIEW

An integrated foundation.

Avarthana's Agilex FPGA radar processing platform combines programmable processing, local DDR4 memory and optical data exchange for modular radar architectures. The antenna-backplane implementation connects distributed acquisition electronics to the radar processing chain. Reference timing, digital I/O and board monitoring support coordinated operation. Application firmware defines the signal-processing pipeline and data interfaces for each deployment.

Adaptive processing: Programmable hardware for application-specific radar data pipelines.

Optical data exchange: 64-lane optical connectivity target, subject to device and link allocation.

Local DDR4 memory: 32 GB programmable-logic and 16 GB processing-memory interface targets.

Network interfaces: Three 10/25GbE SFP interfaces and one copper 10GbE target.

Timing and control: 100 MHz reference, SYSREF and IRIG-B timing provisions.

Thermal management: Conduction/liquid cooling options with monitoring and diagnostics.

ENGINEERING DETAILS

Technical specifications

Processing & memory

Processing architectureAgilex FPGA; device and package selected per configuration
Programmable-logic memory1 x 32 GB DDR4 interface target
Processing memory1 x 16 GB DDR4 interface target
Non-volatile memory32 GB eMMC; 2 Gb flash (256 MB)
Removable / SSD storageTwo SD interfaces; 2 TB SSD target; allocation configurable

Optical, Ethernet & digital I/O

Optical serial I/O64 lanes through optical transceivers (configuration target)
Additional serial I/ORemaining serial lanes allocated through SFP interfaces
SFP Ethernet3 x 25GbE / 10GbE targets
Copper Ethernet1 x 10GbE target
GPIO40 single-ended / differential I/O target
Debug / serviceDevice-specific JTAG / debug; USB service interface; one UART
Serial-link allocationLane counts are design targets; device capacity, optical modules and physical routing define the achievable implementation.

Clock & synchronization

Clock inputs / outputs100 MHz external / internal; SYSREF and 100 MHz outputs
Time referenceIRIG-B interface and time stamping

Antenna-backplane integration

Mechanical integrationAntenna-backplane processing assembly; mounting configurable
Power architectureInput rails and power budget defined per assembly
Data pathOptical interfaces connect antenna-side acquisition electronics to downstream radar processing.
Interface allocationConnector layout, optical population, timing distribution and mounting are defined for the selected antenna assembly.

Monitoring, thermal & diagnostics

Health monitoringOver/undervoltage and temperature; status LEDs and fault reporting
Thermal sensingAt least two sensors connected to the processing device
DiagnosticsHardware loopback and built-in-test provisions
CoolingConduction-cooled and liquid-cooled design options

Reliability & qualification targets

Reliability targetMTBF: 30,000 hours at +65 C
Endurance target168 hours of continuous operation testing
Qualification targetsMIL-STD-810H ESS; MIL-STD-461G: CS116, RS103, CE102, RE102
